text:
maria (eng-infra): Kicking off ZA-south1 cluster bring-up tomorrow. Need GPU quota (A100) + network preflight. Who can own quota request and routing checks?

sanjay (cloudops): I can take quota. Are we doing committed/reserved or spot-backed first?

maria (eng-infra): Start with short reserved for smoke (4x A100), can fallback to spot for scale. Need /quota template below.

maria (eng-infra): ```json
{
  "project": "redwood-inference-prod-za",
  "region": "za-south1",
  "resource": "a100-gpu",
  "quantity": 4,
  "duration_months": 3,
  "reason": "cluster bring-up + validation",
  "contact": "maria@redwood.com"
}
```

ken (eng-sre): Network note: peering to main VPC will need 1Gbps baseline; make sure to disable IP masquerade for the private range. Also watch for MTU mismatch on the edge routers.

sanjay (cloudops): Filing quota request now. Using internal form: https://internal.redwood/qreq — will CC @julie for cost signoff.

julie (finance): Quick cost estimate: 4x A100 reserved ~ $24k/month. If we go spot for scale expect 50–70% cheaper but preemption risk. Approve provisional spend for 3 months.

capacity-bot: Quota request 2164007782 submitted. Estimated approval 48–72h. Track: https://internal.redwood/quotas/2164007782

alex (ops-oncall): Ops checklist: bootstrap nodes image (rwi-2026-02-18), kubelet flags, nvidia-drivers 535.*, and nvlink tuning. Also need to run node e2e storage test.

maria (eng-infra): Sanjay — can you add requested routes and firewall tags in the ticket? Need to open TCP 50051 (inference), 9300 (metrics), 22 for onboarding only.

sanjay (cloudops): Added firewall patch: 'za-infer-allow' and route 'za-to-core' to ticket. Also noted MTU ask to network team.

ken (eng-sre): Scheduling validation window: Tue 07:00–10:00 UTC. We'll run smoke, load test to 2k concurrents, and KV cache warmup. I'll own the load runner.

maria (eng-infra): For rollback plan: if latencies >1200ms p50 under test, we fallback to eu-west3 burst pool and cut traffic via smart-routing. Ops playbook linked: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/region-fallback

julie (finance): Also, alert me if expected burn > $100k in first month. We can flip to spot + autoscale if it spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary manifest applied to za-south1 cluster at 2164009000 by maria (eng-infra).

ken (eng-sre): Small gotcha — the cloud provider assigns ephemeral IPs slower in ZA region; add 30s to node join timeout in kube controller.

maria (eng-infra): Noted. Sanjay, ping me when quota approved and when routes are in place. I'll start the kube apply.

sanjay (cloudops): Quota approved 2164009800. PR #452 added firewall and routes. Dropping logs and links in ticket.

maria (eng-infra): Thanks — starting bootstrap now. Will post results.

alex (ops-oncall): If bootstrap fails on driver install, try `sudo apt-get install -y --allow-downgrades nvidia-drivers-535` then restart kubelet.

maria (eng-infra): Bootstrap finished. Nodes ready, basic inference smoke passed. Next: load test at 08:00 UTC.

ken (eng-sre): Load test underway 2164010500 — initial p50 320ms p95 940ms. KV cache warming in progress. No packet loss.

julie (finance): Noted spend so far: ~$6.3k. Keeping an eye.

maria (eng-infra): Closing loop — handoff doc updated: https://internal.redwood/handovers/za-south1. Assigning oncall @alex for first 48h.
